summary: Cheer Holding, Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting that at its 2026 Annual General Meeting, shareholders approved an increase in authorized share capital from US$500,699.95 to US$7,500,700.00 by creating 46,666,667 additional Class A ordinary shares of US$0.15 par value each. The increase was effected through a notice filed with the Cayman Islands Registrar of Companies on July 7, 2026, and incorporated into the company's memorandum and articles. No acquisition, divestiture, tender, or other special-situation event is described. This is a routine capital-structure housekeeping item.
